t: 弗拉迪斯劳斯二世,波希米亚公爵出任波希米亚国王.
te: Vladislaus II, Duke of Bohemia becomes King of Bohemia.
dz: 弗拉迪斯劳斯二世,波希米亚公爵出任波希米亚国王.
de: Vladislaus II, Duke of Bohemia becomes King of Bohemia.

t: 德国城市慕尼黑 (München) 在神圣罗马帝国皇帝弗里德里希一世在奥格斯堡仲裁中首次被提及…
te: German city Munich (München) is first mentioned as forum apud Munichen in the Augsburg arbitration by Holy Roman Empero…
dz: 德国城市慕尼黑 (München) 在神圣罗马帝国皇帝弗里德里希一世在奥格斯堡仲裁中首次被提及为论坛 apud 慕尼黑。
de: German city Munich (München) is first mentioned as forum apud Munichen in the Augsburg arbitration by Holy Roman Emperor Friedrich I.

t: 慕尼黑市由狮子亨利在伊萨尔河畔建立。
te: The city of Munich is founded by Henry the Lion on the banks of the river Isar.
dz: 慕尼黑市由狮子亨利在伊萨尔河畔建立。
de: The city of Munich is founded by Henry the Lion on the banks of the river Isar.
